questions.stem: In which exact year did Mahatma Gandhi permanently return to India from South Africa, a monumental event that marked the beginning of the 'Gandhian era' in Indian politics?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi returned to India from South Africa on January 9, 1915. At the request of Gopal Krishna Gokhale, he spent his first year traveling across India to understand the people and their problems. This day is now celebrated as Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.
